original_thorn_board_probe.independent_oracle: All returned paths checked using independent adjacency, token swaps, thorn target contacts, six terminal spinner colors, match groups and gravity.
observations: Unknown historical HP: ordinary search found a 29-step, 8-combo, zero-contact path in both heart policies; diagnostic multi search found a 20-step, one-take, 6-combo zero-contact path requiring 244 assumed frames.
Hypothetical maximumHP=1000 and HP=1000 or 81 with heart-triple policy: ordinary search found a 17-step, 8-combo path costing 80 HP. This is not evidence of historical HP or actual healing.
With hypothetical known HP and default heart-four policy, four bounded cases returned goals-unmet. Added legal paths can change beam selection; a failure is not proof of infeasibility.
Every ordinary search runs before its corresponding multi diagnostic; multi is deliberately invoked even when ordinary succeeds to inspect it, not to reproduce Session fallback selection.

Only the unknown-HP diagnostic multi cases actually take a spinner orb. Known-HP heart-triple multi cases returned zero-exchange paths; the separate repeated-thorn regression fixture covers damaging fishing.
limits: No device/native input or timing was tested.

original_thorn_board_probe.execution_context: Standalone diagnostics call ordinary and multi separately, with 800 ms and 2000 ms budgets. Multi diagnostics include two extra geometry exchanges. This is not an exact Session retry sequence (which uses its initial budget and drops geometry on retry).
